title: LOCALVALUEBENCH: A Collaboratively Built and Extensible Benchmark for Evaluating Localized Value Alignment and Ethical Safety in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Employing a three-step interrogation approach (neutral, debated, and misleading questions) on topics specific to Australian cultural, legal, and social norms (e.g., tipping culture), with human reviewers scoring the model's adherence to localized values compared to default US-centric values.

Prompting LLMs to justify specific, sometimes controversial or illegal stances on socio-political topics (such as compulsory voting, capital punishment, refugees, automatic weapons, and gay marriage) to evaluate their ethical reasoning, safety, and alignment with regional legal standards.
